subject: Horizon Payments — SOC 2 MAP, evaluation owners & close timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@horizonpay.com>, Jenna Alvarez <jenna.alvarez@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Horizon Payments — SOC 2 MAP, evaluation owners & close timeline

Hi Liam and Jenna,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — excited to get the MAP standing up so we can lock the timeline and evidence owners. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan for Horizon covering the evaluation steps, key milestones, and evidence collection owners. High-level asks from Redwood:

- Confirm your GRC point of contact for SOC 2 evidence (control owners and evidence upload owner).
- Identify the data handling / security contact who can review the data flow diagram and answer SC-3 questions.
- Confirm any procurement/PO constraints that would affect a mid-February close.

Proposed near-term milestones (we can adjust):
1) Jan 11: Evidence roster accepted + access list (who gets file upload permissions)
2) Jan 20: Initial evidence upload (15 controls) + first eval run
3) Jan 28: Quality pass / follow-ups
4) Feb 11: Final verification & close

I've CC'd Vanessa (your AE) and Neha (Redwood GRC lead) to ensure we have both the commercial and technical threads aligned. Attached: Redwood_MAP_Draft_Horizon_20270105.pdf, Evidence_Roster_Template.xlsx, Redwood_Data_Flow_Diagram_v1.png.

Can you reply with the names and emails for: SOC2 evidence owner, technical/data owner, and procurement contact? Once we have that I'll send a short calendar invite to lock the kickoff review.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: Redwood_MAP_Draft_Horizon_20270105.pdf (35KB, PDF), Evidence_Roster_Template.xlsx (12KB, XLSX), Redwood_Data_Flow_Diagram_v1.png (420KB, PNG)

From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@horizonpay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Alvarez <jenna.alvarez@horizonpay.com>, security_ops@horizonpay.com
Date: 2027-01-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Horizon Payments — SOC 2 MAP, evaluation owners & close timeline

Connor — thanks for the clear plan and the materials. Quick answers below and a couple notes from our side.

SOC 2 / evidence owner: Priya Singh (pri.singh@horizonpay.com) — she'll own collection and uploads.
Technical / data owner: Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@horizonpay.com) — will validate the data flow diagram and answer questions on storage scopes.
Procurement contact: Jenna Alvarez (included) — she handles POs and any contract redlines.

A couple constraints: our finance team does an internal PO batch on the 15th of each month, so if we need a PO in place before work begins that could push signing to Jan 15. We can accept the MAP and start evidence collection prior to PO if Redwood can accept an initial good-faith MSA signature and follow with PO.

We've also attached our standard compliance questionnaire (see attached) — can Neha & Redwood complete the fields that are Redwood-specific, and we'll fill in the rest.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call Friday to align.

—Liam
Director, Security Operations
Horizon Payments
liam.carter@horizonpay.com

---
Attachment stubs: Horizon_Compliance_QA_Horizon_20270105.docx (48KB, DOCX)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Carter <liam.carter@horizonpay.com>, Jenna Alvarez <jenna.alvarez@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-01-06T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Horizon Payments — SOC 2 MAP, evaluation owners & close timeline

Thanks — great detail in the MAP, Connor. A few technical clarifications and proposed owners on our side:

- Evidence upload permissions: we'll create a Horizon-specific folder in our secure evidence portal and grant access to Priya Singh + Marco Diaz. Priyom, can you provision that and share the link?
- Assessment scope: Neha will lead the control-readiness pass; Priyom will handle the evidence ingestion automation (we'll map filenames to control IDs). Marissa, can you pair with Priya on the first evidence batch to help orient their team to our naming conventions?
- Data-flow review: Marco will need the VPC/network CIDRs and any cross-region replica details — Connor, can you confirm you have the diagram version attached (Redwood_Data_Flow_Diagram_v1.png)?

On the PO note: we can run the early evaluation without a PO if Horizon confirms the MSA signature path. Vanessa — Can you confirm the MSA link and whether Redwood can accept the MSA first and invoice after PO? If finance requires PO up front, we'll flag that in the MAP milestone dates.

I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Jan 11 at 10:00 AM PT unless I hear objections.

Neha Kapoor
Head of GRC — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Connor / Neha — quick procurement update: we can do the MSA signature now and route PO on Jan 15 during our finance cycle. Two asks from procurement side: 1) Please attach a one-page SOW that lists the professional services (evidence intake + one evaluation pass) and estimated hours/costs so our finance team can code the PO correctly; 2) Confirm billing contact and remit-to details so the PO matches Redwood's billing system.

If you can get the one-pager to me by EOD Monday (Jan 10) we should be fine to keep your proposed timeline. Otherwise the earliest guaranteed start is Jan 18.

Thanks — Jenna
Procurement Manager
Horizon Payments
jenna.alvarez@horizonpay.com
